sentences.en: I need to buy a new washing machine because the old one broke down.
sentences.zh: 我得买一个新的洗衣机，因为旧的那个坏了。

sentences.en: Our apartment has a modern washing machine in the laundry room.
sentences.zh: 我们公寓的洗衣房里有一台现代化的洗衣机。

sentences.en: She prefers to do her laundry by hand instead of using the washing machine.
sentences.zh: 她更喜欢用手洗衣服，而不是用洗衣机。
